intro: Compact and clever, this Upmods bedside table adds easy-access storage and premium style to your bedroom’s coziest corner.

features.title: Dual storage for everyday essentials
features.text: Open and closed compartments help you organize books, glasses, or remotes—neat on the outside, functional within.

features.title: Premium build for lasting durability
features.text: Crafted from quality materials with a PU finish, it’s built to last—resistant to daily wear while staying visually sleek.

features.title: Fits anywhere beautifully
features.text: Its compact design is space-smart yet offers ample storage, making it perfect for small bedrooms or guest rooms.

features.title: Warm, cozy finish
features.text: Gunmetal and PLT tones add depth and elegance, pairing easily with light and dark interiors alike.

features.title: Easy to assemble
features.text: Simple construction means quick setup—just what you need to complete your room with zero stress.

name: Upmods Prelaminated Particle Board Bedside Table
